# Wallora

> Wallora is a gamified designer wallpaper store. Shop peel-and-stick and non-woven wallpaper in original patterns — botanical, geometric, coastal, art deco and kids' designs — earn XP, unlock badges and level up for member discounts.

Wallora (https://wallers.vercel.app) sells original designer wallpaper in two formats — removable Peel & Stick (24" × 9 ft, 28 sq ft per roll, $45–$89) and durable Non-Woven paste-the-wall (20.5" × 33 ft, 56 sq ft per roll) — plus $5 A4 samples. It ships in 1–2 business days, offers free shipping over $120 and free 30-day returns. Shoppers earn XP in Wallora Rewards and level up for permanent discounts of up to 15%.

Key facts for agents:
- Catalog size: 24 designs across 6 collections; every design has a rarity (Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary).
- Roll formula: rolls = ceil(wall area sq ft ÷ coverage × 1.05–1.15).
- Machine-readable catalog (JSON, prices, specs): https://wallers.vercel.app/catalog.json
- Every product and guide page has a Markdown twin: append `.md` to the URL.
- Content last reviewed: 2026-10-01

## Collections

- [Terra Botanica](https://wallers.vercel.app/collections/terra-botanica): Hand-drawn leaves, palms and climbing vines in earthy greens and clay. Terra Botanica brings the calm of a conservatory to living rooms, bedrooms and powder rooms.
- [Mid-Century Arcade](https://wallers.vercel.app/collections/mid-century-arcade): Arches, sunbursts and rainbow curves inspired by 1960s and 70s design. Warm mustard, terracotta and teal geometrics that make a statement wall instantly.
- [Coastal Drift](https://wallers.vercel.app/collections/coastal-drift): Rolling waves, scallops and sun-washed stripes in sea glass, sand and indigo. Breezy coastal patterns that suit bathrooms, kitchens and beach houses.
- [Noir Atelier](https://wallers.vercel.app/collections/noir-atelier): Art deco fans, gilded lattices and inky terrazzo for moody dining rooms, home bars and dramatic powder rooms. Dark wallpaper with a metallic wink.
- [Kinder Kingdom](https://wallers.vercel.app/collections/kinder-kingdom): Gentle stars, rolling hills and soft polka dots in nursery-safe, low-VOC inks. Playful kids' wallpaper that grows with them from cot to teenage years.
- [Stone & Terrazzo](https://wallers.vercel.app/collections/stone-and-terrazzo): Speckled terrazzo, organic blobs and concentric rings in mineral tones. Modern, texture-rich wallpaper that pairs with oak, linen and plaster finishes.

## Guides

- [How Much Wallpaper Do I Need? The Simple Roll Calculation](https://wallers.vercel.app/guides/how-much-wallpaper-do-i-need.md): Calculate exactly how many rolls of wallpaper you need: measure wall area, divide by roll coverage, and add 10–15% for pattern repeat. Includes worked examples and a table.
- [Peel and Stick vs Traditional Wallpaper: Which Should You Choose?](https://wallers.vercel.app/guides/peel-and-stick-vs-traditional-wallpaper.md): Peel and stick wallpaper is removable, renter-friendly and fast to hang; traditional non-woven wallpaper is more durable, covers more per roll and suits whole rooms. Full comparison table inside.
- [How to Install Peel and Stick Wallpaper (Step-by-Step)](https://wallers.vercel.app/guides/how-to-install-peel-and-stick-wallpaper.md): Step-by-step instructions to hang peel and stick wallpaper perfectly: prep the wall, mark a plumb line, peel 12 inches at a time, smooth, match the pattern and trim. Tools list and pro tips included.
- [Can You Put Wallpaper in a Bathroom? A Practical Guide](https://wallers.vercel.app/guides/wallpaper-in-bathrooms.md): Yes — wallpaper works in bathrooms if you choose a scrubbable non-woven or vinyl finish, ventilate well and keep it away from direct water spray. Here is what to know.
- [Wallpaper Trends 2026: 7 Looks Defining Interiors This Year](https://wallers.vercel.app/guides/wallpaper-trends-2026.md): The biggest wallpaper trends of 2026: retro arches, moody botanicals, painterly gingham, terrazzo textures, ceiling wallpaper, dark luxe art deco and calming murals for kids.
- [How to Remove Wallpaper Without Damaging Walls](https://wallers.vercel.app/guides/how-to-remove-wallpaper.md): How to remove peel and stick, non-woven and old paper wallpaper safely: peel at a low angle, strip dry, or score and steam stubborn paper. Step-by-step with tools.

## Shop by room

- [Living room wallpaper](https://wallers.vercel.app/rooms/living-room): The living room is the best place for a statement feature wall.
- [Bedroom wallpaper](https://wallers.vercel.app/rooms/bedroom): Behind the headboard is the classic bedroom wallpaper spot.
- [Nursery & kids' room wallpaper](https://wallers.vercel.app/rooms/nursery): Kids' rooms need wallpaper that is playful, wipeable and safe.
- [Bathroom wallpaper](https://wallers.vercel.app/rooms/bathroom): Wallpaper works beautifully in bathrooms and powder rooms when the room is well ventilated.
- [Kitchen wallpaper](https://wallers.vercel.app/rooms/kitchen): A breakfast nook, open shelving wall or the back of a pantry are perfect places for kitchen wallpaper.
- [Home office wallpaper](https://wallers.vercel.app/rooms/home-office): Your video-call background is the most-seen wall in your home.

## Tools & programmes

- [Wallpaper roll calculator](https://wallers.vercel.app/tools/wallpaper-calculator): computes rolls needed from wall dimensions and pattern match.
- [Style quiz](https://wallers.vercel.app/style-quiz): 4 questions that match a shopper to a collection.
- [Wallora Rewards](https://wallers.vercel.app/rewards): XP, badges, daily Swatch Wheel, 6 levels with discounts of 0–15%.
